blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Budget and Management chief Amenah Pangandaman was supposedly aware of the so-called “leadership fund” within the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) budget for 2025, while President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. was not. A witness gave this testimony to the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division on Tuesday. Ex-DPWH chief Manuel Bonoan made the revelation as he testified against Sen. Jinggoy Estrada during the latter’s bail hearing stemming from alleged kickbacks in the 2025 budget worth P573 million, according to special prosecutors. Bonoan was Estrada’s co-accused in this case, but the Fifth Division allowed special prosecutors to discharge him, as […]...
